title: Promo Optimization Engine
text:
Overview
Which promotions actually create incremental sales, and how should a retailer schedule them? This project works through that question with three components, using the Dunnhumby The Complete Journey household-level transaction data: 

Causal uplift modelling: estimate the incremental effect of promotions (display, mailer, coupon) on purchase behaviour, rather than raw lift.
Promo calendar optimisation: use the uplift estimates to choose which products to promote and when, subject to budget and frequency constraints.
Bayesian marketing mix model: estimate channel-level contributions with adstock and saturation, with uncertainty intervals.
